title: Pokemon SV04: Paradox Rift: Lokix - 122/182 Holofoil
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card is a must-have for any serious collector. With its stunning holo finish, it is sure to be the centerpiece of your collection. The card is part of the Paradox Rift set and features Lokix, a powerful and mysterious Pokémon.

This card is a great addition to any collection, whether you are a fan of the Pokémon TCG or just love collecting cards. It is manufactured in 2023 and is a Pokémon card, making it an essential part of any collection. Don't miss your chance to own this amazing card!
